name: Rudy Rochefort
original_name: ルディ・ロシュフォール
source:
A Noble Guardian of the Mirage.

The young director of the "Bureau" that exists in Mirage.
They possess high ideals and pride, and dislike lies and conspiracy.

For some reason, they treat the protagonist—whom they have never met—with coldness.
There seems to be a reason behind his appointment as director at an unusually young age...
